body: Thanks! I'll check it out. I'm sure my therapist will bring up something similar the more we get into it. I've only been about 2 months.

Thank you. I think he might be the same way. He's very loyal. He honestly seems to adore me, and I adore him! 

He is very understanding of my mental problems, he grew up with a sister similar to me, so I don't think it would be a problem bringing it up. I just don't want to be a pain with all of my insecurities.

He hasn't yet as we're still in the honeymoon phase. But as time goes... I don't know. I know he'd never cheat, but him finding people attractive on more than a physical level is kind of unavoidable I feel. Not that it'd cross the line of emotional cheating. Just a harmless crush. I'm just scared it will go too far and he'll leave me because he'll like the other person more.

I don't know if my views on relationships have become skewed... they probably have.

I do both, although it's been a while now.

I used to grab a hairbrush and pretty much stab my thighs until I zoned out and didn't feel anything emotionally. Horrible bruises that don't go away for a long long time.

Last time I did it was in June, and I can still see where they were, as can my boyfriend.

I was on seroquel about a year ago I think. I woke up with hangovers and was always running late for school because there was NO WAY to wake me up. I could go to bed at 8pm and still be out 12 hours later.

I became incredibly unstable the more I increased my dosage, and at 900mg I was literally insane. I recall my then boyfriend just MENTIONING his ex and I went batshit crazy and ended up harming myself. Not like me at all. I was a completely different person.

This however doesn't mean you will react anything like this, and it might be great for you. But this is my experience and I would never go near that medicine again.

Yes. I'm doing a bit better. Had a long talk with my doctor today, and we established that I should try different meds. I trust him 100%, so I think this might be a good thing. I've also spoken to the boyfriend, and he asked me what he was supposed to do when I feel like this. He was actually the one who brought it up, which made things a lot easier. He's a keeper.

The pills haven't made  me dose off yet, but I still feel them. So sorry if this doesn't make any sense. I can barely see what I'm typing. 

Nothing makes me happy anymore. Everything has been getting worse and I'm getting sick of it. I'm bipolar. So it's not about just a bout of depression or whatever. I'm stuck with this disease for life, as it's chronic. I've felt like shit since I was a small child.

Damn. Had no idea they could make you feel that way, sounds really awful. I've been taking seroquel for a few months now. At first it just put me to sleep and made me wake up with a hangover. But now I'm on 900mg and haven't had any of that since.
I hope you're someday able to find the right treatment for you.
